name: cs-engine
description: An AI Customer Success operating system for your book of business. Pulls a Customer 360 from the CRM, support desk, call recorder, surveys and product data you already have connected; scores health with full explainability; runs churn root-cause analysis, renewal defense, onboarding acceleration, feature-depth audits, expansion whitespace and executive business reviews; and returns every recommendation as an evidence-backed, approval-gated action.
